```{r}
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

lung25_1 <- readH5AD("~/Desktop/adata_lung_25_rep1.h5ad")
lung25_2 <- readH5AD("~/Desktop/adata_lung_25_rep2.h5ad")
lung25_3 <- readH5AD("~/Desktop/adata_lung_25_rep3.h5ad")
```


```{r}
meta_lung25_1 <- as.data.frame(colData(lung25_1))

raw_counts_lung25_1 <- assay(lung25_1, "counts")

lung25_1_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = raw_counts_lung25_1,
  meta.data = meta_lung25_1
)

lung25_1_list <- SplitObject(lung25_1_seurat, split.by = "batch")

lung25_1_list <- lapply(lung25_1_list, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(
    x,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = 2000,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  x
})

features_lung25_1 <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = lung25_1_list)

lung25_1_list <- lapply(lung25_1_list, function(x) {
  x <- ScaleData(x, features = features_lung25_1, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- RunPCA(x, features = features_lung25_1, verbose = FALSE)
  x
})

lung25_1_anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = lung25_1_list,
  anchor.features = features_lung25_1,
  reduction = "rpca"
)

lung25_1_integrated <- IntegrateData(
  anchorset = lung25_1_anchors,
  k.weight = 50
)

DefaultAssay(lung25_1_integrated) <- "integrated"

lung25_1_integrated <- ScaleData(lung25_1_integrated, verbose = FALSE)
lung25_1_integrated <- RunPCA(lung25_1_integrated, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
lung25_1_integrated <- RunUMAP(lung25_1_integrated, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
lung25_1_integrated <- FindNeighbors(lung25_1_integrated, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
lung25_1_integrated <- FindClusters(lung25_1_integrated, resolution = 0.5)
```

```{r}
meta_out_lung25_1 <- lung25_1_integrated@meta.data
meta_out_lung25_1$cell_id <- rownames(meta_out_lung25_1)
meta_out_lung25_1$cluster <- meta_out_lung25_1$integrated_snn_res.0.5

pca_out_lung25_1 <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(lung25_1_integrated, "pca")[, 1:30])
colnames(pca_out_lung25_1) <- paste0("PC_", 1:30)
pca_out_lung25_1$cell_id <- rownames(pca_out_lung25_1)

export_out_lung25_1 <- merge(meta_out_lung25_1, pca_out_lung25_1, by = "cell_id")

write.csv(
  export_out_lung25_1,
  "~/Desktop/lung_seurat_25_rep1.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

lung_list <- list(
  lung25_1 = lung25_1,
  lung25_2 = lung25_2,
  lung25_3 = lung25_3
)

lung_mnn_list <- list()

for (nm in names(lung_list)) {
  
  sce_obj <- lung_list[[nm]]
  
  sce_obj <- logNormCounts(sce_obj)
  dec_obj <- modelGeneVar(sce_obj)
  chosen_hvgs_obj <- getTopHVGs(dec_obj, n = 2000)
  
  mnn_obj <- fastMNN(
    sce_obj,
    batch = sce_obj$batch,
    subset.row = chosen_hvgs_obj
  )
  
  colData(mnn_obj)$cell_type <- colData(sce_obj)$cell_type
  
  lung_mnn_list[[nm]] <- mnn_obj
  
  metadata(mnn_obj)$merge.info <- NULL
  out_path <- paste0("~/Desktop/", nm, "_fastmnn.h5ad")
  writeH5AD(mnn_obj, out_path)
  
}
```
